verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair axis for a government e-filing platform. The pack only hints at one: it names an 'ERiC developer-artifact host' as the sanctioned software channel, and ELSTER says any supporting tax software can transmit through its rail. A single un-retried probe of that host timed out, and no first-party SDK documentation appears. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official SDK (ERiC) with languages and APIs, developer onboarding/access terms, reliable artifact availability, and independent or hands-on confirmation of building against it.
